categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/linearize/linearize-data.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes a Python 3 regression where checking byte values against '\0' instead of 0 causes linearize-data.py to hang indefinitely on null-padded block files. While linearize is a niche utility script, resolving an infinite read loop is a clear correctness fix.
